name: browser_click
title: Click element on webpage
description: Click an HTML element matching a CSS selector in the active browser page.

selector.description: CSS selector of element to click (e.g. 'button.submit', '#login', 'a[href="/about"]')

timeout_ms.description: Wait timeout for element in milliseconds

name: browser_close
title: Close browser
description: Close the browser launched by this server. If attached via browser_connect, only disconnects and leaves the user's browser and tabs open.

name: browser_connect
title: Connect to running browser
description: Attach to an already running Chrome/Edge with its open tabs, cookies and logged-in sessions via the remote debugging port, instead of launching a new browser. After connecting, browser_get_content, browser_evaluate, browser_screenshot, browser_click and browser_type work on the selected tab (by default the tab the user is looking at). The browser must run with --remote-debugging-port=9222 and a non-default --user-data-dir; set launch_if_missing=true to start such a browser with a persistent profile.

endpoint.description: DevTools endpoint: a port (9222), http://127.0.0.1:9222 or ws://... Defaults to BROWSER_CDP_URL or http://127.0.0.1:9222

launch_if_missing.description: If nothing listens on the endpoint, start Chrome/Edge with remote debugging and a persistent profile (it stays open after disconnect)

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for a started browser to accept connections

name: browser_evaluate
title: Execute JavaScript in browser
description: Evaluate arbitrary JavaScript code inside the active browser webpage context. Returns the evaluated value as JSON.

script.description: JavaScript code or expression to run (e.g. document.title, window.__STATE__, or an async function)

name: browser_get_content
title: Get webpage content
description: Extract readable text, raw HTML, or title from the active webpage or a specific selector. Long content comes in pages: while truncated is true, continue from next_offset.

length.description: Maximum number of characters to return

offset.description: First character to return (UTF-16 index); pass next_offset from the previous page

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to target a specific container element

type.description: Type of content: 'text' (rendered text), 'html' (DOM HTML), or 'title'

name: browser_list_tabs
title: List browser tabs
description: List open tabs (index, url, title, whether visible to the user and whether active for browser_* tools) in the current browser session.

name: browser_navigate
title: Navigate to URL
description: Navigate the active browser page to a new URL.

name: browser_new_tab
title: Open new tab
description: Open a new tab in the current browser session (optionally navigating to a URL) and make it the active tab for browser_* tools.

url.description: URL to open in the new tab

name: browser_open
title: Open URL in browser
description: Open a webpage in host browser (Chrome or Edge). By default launches a visible browser window (headless=false) so you can test web applications visually.

browser.description: Preferred browser (defaults to Google Chrome, falls back to Microsoft Edge)

headless.description: If false (default), opens a real visible browser window. If true, runs headlessly.

url.description: The URL to open (e.g. http://localhost:3000, http://127.0.0.1:8080, https://...)

name: browser_screenshot
title: Take webpage screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the active browser page. Can save to file or return base64.

full_page.description: Whether to capture full scrollable page or visible viewport only

path.description: Optional file path to save PNG screenshot to (e.g. 'screenshots/test1.png')

name: browser_select_tab
title: Select browser tab
description: Choose which open tab subsequent browser_* tools operate on: by index (from browser_list_tabs), by URL or title substring, or with no arguments the tab the user is currently looking at.

bring_to_front.description: Also switch the visible tab in the browser window

title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the tab title

url_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the tab URL

name: browser_type
title: Type text into element
description: Type text into an input or textarea element on the active browser page.

clear.description: Whether to clear existing text before typing

text.description: Text string to type into the element

timeout_ms.description: Wait timeout for element in milliseconds

name: file_delete
title: Delete a path
description: Permanently delete a file or directory. Recursive directory deletion must be explicitly enabled.

path.description: Path of file or directory to delete

recursive.description: Required to be true to delete non-empty directories

name: file_list
title: List files
description: List files and directories at a host path. When truncated is true, continue from next_offset.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of items to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip; pass next_offset from the previous page

name: file_mkdir
title: Create a directory
description: Create a directory and any missing parent directories.

name: file_move
title: Move or rename a path
description: Move or rename a file or directory.

name: file_read
title: Read a file
description: Read a text or binary file from the host filesystem. UTF-8 chunks never split a character; while truncated is true, continue from next_offset.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from

path.description: Path to the file to read

name: file_replace
title: Replace text in file
description: Replace an exact substring or block of code in a file without rewriting the whole file.

allow_multiple.description: If true, replaces all occurrences. If false, fails if target appears more than once.

target.description: The exact text/code chunk to replace

name: file_search
title: Search files
description: Search files by name pattern (e.g. *.ts) and/or search for text/regex inside file contents. Files that could not be searched (larger than MAX_FILE_BYTES, unreadable) are listed in skipped; non-UTF-8 text is decoded with the system code page.

case_sensitive.description: Whether content search is case sensitive

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

query.description: Text or regex to search inside file contents

name: file_stat
title: Inspect a path
description: Return metadata for a file or directory.

name: file_write
title: Write a file
description: Create, overwrite, or append to a file. Parent directories are created automatically.

append.description: If true, appends data to the end of the file

data.description: Content to write into the file

path.description: Path to the file to write

name: terminal_execute
title: Execute a terminal command
description: Execute a PowerShell or cmd command on the host. This has unrestricted host privileges when FULL_ACCESS=true. Output over MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES is cut at a character boundary (truncated: true); redirect long output to a file and read it with file_read.

shell.description: Shell type to execute command in

timeout_ms.description: Command timeout in milliseconds (default: COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS, max: 900000)

name: workspace_get_cwd
title: Get current working directory
description: Get the current active working directory and files root.

name: workspace_set_cwd
title: Set current working directory
description: Change the active working directory for subsequent file operations and terminal commands (e.g. 'sandustry'). Allows using short relative paths within that project.

path.description: Subdirectory name or path to set as current working directory
